# Variable `UBOOT_MAKE_TARGET`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the target called in the `Makefile`. The default target is “all”.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-UBOOT_MAKE_TARGET
